release_notes: Session recordings for whole sites: a campaign-level switch (campaign → Integrations) records organic sites with tracking.js on every page — one visit is one multi-page recording with page transitions in the player, a click heatmap per page, and filters by campaign, traffic source and page. An opt-in "one click per visit" mode glues a visitor's pages into a single click (same-site navigation within 30 minutes; ad markers are re-checked, so a new paid click always gets its own click and attribution — off by default, the update changes nobody's numbers). An EU cookie-consent mode gates recording behind OrbitraReplay.consent() from your cookie banner, with nothing written — not even heatmap clicks — before the visitor agrees; revoke() withdraws it. Migration 78. Docs: Session recordings.
